source: information_schema.columns on the live node database; projections parsed per SQL statement from backend/src/**/*.ts

legend.not-read: no SQL statement projects or references it
legend.referenced-only: appears in WHERE/JOIN/ORDER BY, never returned
legend.queried-only: projected by SQL, carried by no contract field
legend.transformed-rendered: consumed by a decoder and represented as a semantic value; the raw bytes are never emitted
legend.rendered-presence-verified: a field of this name or recorded alias exists at every layer; the path is not individually traced
legend.contracted-not-rendered: in the contract, no render location
legend.raw-and-transformed-rendered: emitted as raw hex on the detail route AND decoded into a semantic view; the raw form is capped at 64 KB and flagged cborTruncated

columns.raw_path: tx / payload_cbor -> txRow.tx -> decodeTransaction(includeCbor: true) -> cborHex; capped at MAX_INLINE_CBOR_BYTES = 64 KB with cborTruncated: true. List paths (address.ts:46, block.ts:105, transaction.ts:253) call decodeTransactionSafe without includeCbor, so those emit no raw bytes.
